description: Translate text into Unicode braille patterns (Grade 1), including capitals and numbers with the number sign.

faqs.a: Grade 1 braille maps each letter to a dot pattern: a=⠁, b=⠃, c=⠉ and so on, rendered as Unicode braille characters.
The number sign ⠼ comes first, then digits use the letters a–j (⠼⠁ = 1, ⠼⠚ = 0).
Yes — decode braille patterns back to letters, capitals and digits.

title: Braille Translator
